name: Zenouji Miki
source:
The daughter of a prominent family, she is a graceful and elegant young lady who is unashamed of her position as the eldest daughter of a prominent family. She has a strong sense of justice and a winning personality, and even though she has fallen into a position where she is obliged to become a sex slave, she still manages to act stout-heartedly. On the other hand, she is gentle and kind to those whom she has forgiven, including her family.

She is prepared to be a sex slave, so she obeys the protagonist even though she is repulsed by him. She is physically sensitive, and when sensuality is given to her, she becomes aroused against her will. She is often depressed by her disgust with herself, but she has the strength to persevere.
